changeSet.comment: nexus.topics_doc_count_drift: topics whose doc_count disagrees with the real topic_assignments count, one batched query
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.topics_doc_count_drift( p_tenant_id text ) RETURNS TABLE(tenant_id text, topic_id bigint, label text, collection text, doc_count integer, actual_count bigint) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $$ SELECT t.tenant_id, t.id, t.label, t.collection, t.doc_count, COALESCE(a.cnt, 0)::bigint FROM nexus.topics t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, topic_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM nexus.topic_assignments GROUP BY tenant_id, topic_id ) a ON a.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND a.topic_id = t.id WHERE (p_tenant_id IS NULL OR t.tenant_id = p_tenant_id) AND t.doc_count IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(a.cnt, 0) ORDER BY t.tenant_id, t.id $$;
